entry.title: CSXXL 1.0.12
entry.summary: ## CSXXL 1.0.12 A two-layer (A/B), 8-voice, polyphonic synthesizer for the Akai Force and MPC OS, in the spirit of the Yamaha CS-80. A completely new build, not a port: the voices are written from Deckard's Dream voice notes and self-built schematics, emulated in code. Slider-only panel, free, not for sale. ### What is in it - 12 panel pages, picked from an overview of tiles (OVERVIEW and < > in the header) - Per layer: selectable waves incl. white noise, 2-pole HP and LP with mix, sine/sub, CS-
